why:
Perched on act-warden, placed in scn-keep at step 5 — the seat WITH eyes in this golden. Its pair, act-scout, is added and never placed, and the two together are why this scenario is worth two oracles rather than one. Steps 8-12 churn control of act-warden across ana, bo and cy, including a revoke from a participant that was never granted; control events are knows()-gated, not sight-gated, so they should reach this log whether or not anyone is in view. act-herald is NON-party and granted to eli at step 15, which DOES make it a viewpoint for eli's own seat. The rule under test here is the narrower one: it must not make act-herald KNOWN to the other party members, and this stream is where that is checked.

Before this actor enters the world it has no eyes, so no scene, token, move or door reaches this seat. The party ROSTER still does, and so does the sitting where a golden has one (adventure-night has no session at all). Narration would too -- classify forwards it unconditionally -- but NO golden in this corpus has a narration before a party member is added, so nothing here demonstrates it. Roster-gated exposure is recorded by sub-project 14's plan as a product question rather than a sight leak.

This directory is also that plan's ORACLE for this character: what its log must contain once the projection moves to write time. It records today's code, and the port is checked against it.
